s0401.literal: On bingchen day, the tax-collection office of Xuande Prefecture was abolished, and the Shangdu Transport Commission was made to administer it concurrently.
s0401.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Xuande tax office was abolished and its duties assigned to the Shangdu transport commission.

s0402.literal: The tax-collection offices of the Henan, Huaimeng, and Shunde routes were converted into Transport Commissions.
s0402.idiomatic: Tax offices in the Henan, Huaimeng, and Shunde routes were converted into transport commissions.

s0403.literal: On dingyou day, twenty thousand conscripted militia were sent to Xiangyang.
s0403.idiomatic: On dingyou day twenty thousand conscripted militia were sent to Xiangyang.

s0404.literal: Relief grain of five thousand nine hundred ninety-nine shi was issued to impoverished artisan households in Qian Prefecture.
s0404.idiomatic: Five thousand nine hundred ninety-nine shi of relief grain was issued to impoverished artisan households in Qian Prefecture.

s0405.literal: An edict stated: "Henceforth saddles, boots, arrowheads, and the like may not be decorated with gold.
s0405.idiomatic: An edict declared that saddles, boots, arrowheads, and similar items could no longer be decorated with gold.

s0406.literal: Kaiyuan and other routes suffered famine; household cloth levies were reduced by two bolts, autumn taxes cut by half, Udege households had their sable levy reduced by two, and rents and taxes in disaster areas were remitted.
s0406.idiomatic: In Kaiyuan and other famine-stricken routes household cloth levies were cut by two bolts, autumn taxes halved, the sable levy on Udege households reduced by two, and disaster-area rents and taxes remitted.

s0407.literal: One thousand nine hundred-odd households of impoverished sole surviving soldiers were released to become civilians.
s0407.idiomatic: More than nineteen hundred households of impoverished sole surviving soldiers were released to civilian status.

s0408.literal: On guimao day, one thousand ingots of paper notes were issued to the Henan Branch Secretariat to reward the army.
s0408.idiomatic: On guimao day one thousand ingots of paper notes were sent to the Henan branch secretariat to reward the troops.

s0409.literal: In the third month, on jiayin day, an edict ordered Yidu Route to conscript ten thousand troops, each man given twenty-five strings of paper notes.
s0409.idiomatic: On jiayin day of the third month an edict ordered Yidu to conscript ten thousand troops, each man receiving twenty-five strings of notes.

s0410.literal: On wuwu day, Cao Prefecture's famine was relieved.
s0410.idiomatic: On wuwu day relief was issued for the famine in Cao Prefecture.

s0411.literal: A fortress was built at Lumen Mountain.
s0411.idiomatic: A fortress was built at Lumen Mountain.

s0412.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on xinsi day, ten jade seals large and small were made.
s0412.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the fourth month of summer ten jade seals, large and small, were made.

s0413.literal: On jiawu day, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers.
s0413.idiomatic: On jiawu day envoys were sent to sacrifice at the sacred mountains and rivers.

s0414.literal: Daming and other routes suffered famine; one hundred thousand shi of rice was issued for relief.
s0414.idiomatic: Daming and other routes suffered famine; one hundred thousand shi of rice was issued for relief.

s0415.literal: In the fifth month, on bingwu day, Dongping Route suffered famine; forty-one thousand three hundred-odd shi of rice was issued for relief.
s0415.idiomatic: On bingwu day of the fifth month Dongping suffered famine; more than forty-one thousand three hundred shi of rice was issued for relief.

s0416.literal: On xinyou day, an edict forbade frontier garrison soldiers from pasturing livestock on garrison-farm grain crops.
s0416.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict forbade frontier garrison troops from grazing livestock on garrison-farm crops.

s0417.literal: In the sixth month, on xinsi day, because Pacification Commissioner Qiemian's campaign against Jiandu had failed and he had also on his own authority recalled Suohuo'er's imperial patent and gold tally, he was put to death.
s0417.idiomatic: On xinsi day of the sixth month Qiemian, pacification commissioner against Jiandu, was executed for his defeat and for having on his own authority recalled Suohuo'er's imperial patent and gold tally.

s0418.literal: On renwu day, one thousand six hundred twenty-one sole surviving men among newly conscripted troops in Yidu were released to become civilians.
s0418.idiomatic: On renwu day one thousand six hundred twenty-one sole surviving men among Yidu's newly conscripted troops were released to civilian status.

s0419.literal: On dinghai day, locusts struck the prefectures of Henan, Hebei, and Shandong.
s0419.idiomatic: On dinghai day locusts struck prefectures across Henan, Hebei, and Shandong.

s0420.literal: On guisi day, an edict stated: "In Zhending and other routes afflicted by drought and locusts, household levies of substitute laborers for wall-building corvée are all remitted.
s0420.idiomatic: On guisi day an edict remitted household levies for substitute wall-building laborers in drought- and locust-stricken Zhending and other routes.

s0421.literal: On bingchen day, King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent his heir Wang Chŏm to court; Wang Chŏn was granted one jade belt, Wang Chŏm fifty taels of gold, and accompanying officials silver and silk in varying amounts.
s0421.idiomatic: On bingchen day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent Crown Prince Wang Chŏm to court; Wang Chŏn received one jade belt, Wang Chŏm fifty taels of gold, and accompanying officials silver and silk in varying amounts.

s0422.literal: On renyin day, Aju led fifteen thousand troops to block the firewood-gathering routes at Song's Wanshan, Sheduo Ridge, and Guimen Pass.
s0422.idiomatic: On renyin day Aju led fifteen thousand men to cut off Song firewood routes at Wanshan, Sheduo Ridge, and Guimen Pass.

s0423.literal: On guimao day, an edict ordered Dong Wenbing and others to lead twenty-two thousand troops south on campaign.
s0423.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict ordered Dong Wenbing and others to lead twenty-two thousand troops south on campaign.

s0424.literal: Dongchang Route suffered famine; twenty-seven thousand five hundred ninety shi of rice was issued for relief.
s0424.idiomatic: Dongchang suffered famine; twenty-seven thousand five hundred ninety shi of rice was issued for relief.

s0425.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingsi day, forty-five private Song merchants were sent back to their country.
s0425.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the seventh month of autumn forty-five private Song merchants were sent home.

s0426.literal: On gengshen day, naval wanhu Xing Deli, Zhang Zhi, and others captured alive Song Jing-E Commander-in-Chief Tang Yongjian; silver and silk rewards were granted in varying amounts.
s0426.idiomatic: On gengshen day naval wanhu Xing Deli, Zhang Zhi, and others captured Song Jing-E commander-in-chief Tang Yongjian alive; silver and silk rewards were granted in varying amounts.

s0427.literal: On xinyou day, sacrificial robes for the Court of Imperial Sacrifices were made.
s0427.idiomatic: On xinyou day sacrificial robes were made for the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

s0428.literal: On renxu day, Xijing suffered heavy hail.
s0428.idiomatic: On renxu day Xijing was struck by heavy hail.

s0429.literal: On jisi day, Mongol-script schools were established in all routes.
s0429.idiomatic: On jisi day Mongol-script schools were established in every route.

s0430.literal: On guiyou day, the National Academy was established.
s0430.idiomatic: On guiyou day the National Academy was established.

s0431.literal: An edict dispatched officials to review wrongful detentions in all routes; where capital crimes were clearly proven, each was punished according to law; other cases from capital crimes downward were adjudicated and dispatched as appropriate.
s0431.idiomatic: An edict sent officials to review wrongful detentions in all routes; proven capital offenders were punished by law, and lesser cases were adjudicated and disposed of as appropriate.

s0432.literal: Another edict addressed Song officials, soldiers, and civilians, making known the wish not to use force.
s0432.idiomatic: Another edict addressed Song officials, soldiers, and civilians, stating the court's wish to avoid war.

s0433.literal: Commanders-in-Chief Todaiur and Commander Wang Guochang and others were again sent to Goryeo to inspect the prepared warships and survey the roads to Tamna and other places.
s0433.idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Todaiur, commander Wang Guochang, and others were again sent to Goryeo to inspect prepared warships and survey routes to Tamna and elsewhere.

s0434.literal: The Western Sichuan Tea Monopoly Superintendency of Sichuan was established.
s0434.idiomatic: The Western Sichuan tea monopoly superintendency was established in Sichuan.

s0435.literal: Song General Xia Gui led three thousand warships to Lumen Mountain; wanhu Jie Ruji and Li Ting led the fleet to defeat them, capturing and killing more than two thousand men and seizing fifty warships.
s0435.idiomatic: Song general Xia Gui brought three thousand warships to Lumen Mountain; wanhu Jie Ruji and Li Ting led the fleet to defeat them, killing or capturing more than two thousand men and seizing fifty warships.

s0436.literal: In the eighth month, on jimao day, the Jin Prefecture Pacification Commission was established.
s0436.idiomatic: On jimao day of the eighth month the Jin Prefecture pacification commission was established.

s0437.literal: On bingchen day, because the paper-currency system had not yet been implemented in Sha and Suzhou, an edict was issued to instruct them.
s0437.idiomatic: On bingchen day, because paper currency had not yet been implemented in Sha and Suzhou, an edict was issued to instruct them.

s0438.literal: An edict ordered all routes to encourage farming and sericulture.
s0438.idiomatic: An edict ordered every route to encourage farming and sericulture.

s0439.literal: The Central Secretariat was ordered to collect matters of farming and sericulture, set them out in articles, and further instruct the Surveillance and Investigation Commissions together with prefecture and county officials to consider what suited local conditions, study what was feasible, and issue separate regulations.
s0439.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat was ordered to compile farming and sericulture regulations and have surveillance commissions work with prefecture and county officials to adapt them to local conditions, study feasibility, and issue separate rules.

s0440.literal: Goryeo Crown Prince Wang Chŏm memorialized that his country's officials had on their own authority deposed King Wang Chŏn and enthroned his younger brother, Prince of Anqing Wang Chŏ.
s0440.idiomatic: Goryeo crown prince Wang Chŏm reported that his country's officials had deposed King Wang Chŏn on their own authority and enthroned his younger brother, Prince of Anqing Wang Chŏ.

s0441.literal: An edict dispatched Odoci Buga, Li E, and others to go to that country for detailed inquiry and report item by item.
s0441.idiomatic: An edict sent Odoci Buga, Li E, and others to Goryeo for a detailed inquiry and itemized report.

s0442.literal: In the ninth month, on guichou day, En Prefecture presented auspicious grain with one stalk and three ears.
s0442.idiomatic: On guichou day of the ninth month En Prefecture presented auspicious grain with one stalk bearing three ears.

s0443.literal: On wuwu day, an edict stated that private moneylending at interest, even when past the limit, required repayment of only principal plus one period's interest.
s0443.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict ruled that private loans at interest, even when overdue, required repayment of only principal plus one period's interest.

s0444.literal: On jiwei day, Goryeo Crown Prince Wang Chŏm was granted the extraordinary rank of Superior Pillar of State and made Duke of Dong'an.
s0444.idiomatic: On jiwei day Goryeo crown prince Wang Chŏm was granted the extraordinary rank of superior pillar of state and made Duke of Dong'an.

s0445.literal: On renxu day, Feng, Yunnei, and Dongsheng suffered drought; their rents and levies were remitted.
s0445.idiomatic: On renxu day drought struck Feng, Yunnei, and Dongsheng; their rents and levies were remitted.

s0446.literal: On wuchen day, an edict ordered Goryeo Crown Prince Chŏm to lead three thousand troops to his country's crisis; Chŏm declined the title Duke of Dong'an, and was then granted only the extraordinary rank of Superior Pillar of State.
s0446.idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict ordered Goryeo crown prince Chŏm to lead three thousand troops to his country's crisis; Chŏm declined the title Duke of Dong'an and received only the extraordinary rank of superior pillar of state.

s0447.literal: On xinwei day, an edict ordered army-controlling wanhu Song Zhongyi to campaign against Goryeo.
s0447.idiomatic: On xinwei day an edict ordered army-controlling wanhu Song Zhongyi to campaign against Goryeo.

s0448.literal: Huarchu and Shi Tianze were both made Grand Councillors; Ali was made Right Vice Director of the Central Secretariat and administered Branch Secretariat affairs for Henan and other routes; Sayyid Ajall administered Branch Secretariat affairs for the Shaanxi Five Routes, Western Shu, and Sichuan.
s0448.idiomatic: Huarchu and Shi Tianze were both made grand councillors; Ali was made right vice director of the Central Secretariat and placed in charge of the Henan branch secretariat; Sayyid Ajall took charge of the Shaanxi Five Routes, Western Shu, and Sichuan branch secretariat.

s0449.literal: The imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.

s0450.literal: Odoci Buga and Li E, with Goryeo Minister of Justice Kim Pang-gyeong having arrived, presented a memorial from Acting King Wang Chŏ, stating that King Wang Chŏn had fallen gravely ill and had entrusted state affairs to his brother Chŏ.
s0450.idiomatic: Odoci Buga and Li E, with Goryeo minister of justice Kim Pang-gyeong in attendance, presented a memorial from acting king Wang Chŏ claiming that King Wang Chŏn had fallen gravely ill and entrusted affairs of state to his brother Chŏ.

s0451.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jimao day, court ceremonial colors were fixed.
s0451.idiomatic: On jimao day in the tenth month of winter court ceremonial colors were fixed.

s0452.literal: On renwu day, Gaotang and Guanshi were both promoted to prefecture status.
s0452.idiomatic: On renwu day Gaotang and Guanshi were both promoted to prefecture status.

s0453.literal: On dinghai day, Guangping Route suffered drought; rents and levies were remitted.
s0453.idiomatic: On dinghai day Guangping suffered drought; rents and levies were remitted.

s0454.literal: An edict dispatched Vice Minister of War Qara, Guangping Route chief secretary Xu Shixiong, to summon King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo, his brother Wang Chŏ, and powerful minister Lin Yan all to court.
s0454.idiomatic: An edict sent vice minister of war Qara and Guangping route chief secretary Xu Shixiong to summon King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo, his brother Wang Chŏ, and powerful minister Lin Yan to court.

s0455.literal: Prince Touliangge was ordered to press the border with troops; Zhao Bi administered the Branch Secretariat at Dongjing; an edict was also issued to address the soldiers and people of Goryeo.
s0455.idiomatic: Prince Touliangge was ordered to press Goryeo's border with troops; Zhao Bi ran the branch secretariat at Dongjing; and an edict was issued to Goryeo's soldiers and people.

s0456.literal: On gengzi day, the moon infringed upon Mercury.
s0456.idiomatic: On gengzi day the moon infringed upon Mercury.

s0457.literal: The Song sent men bearing salt and grain into Xiangyang; our army seized them.
s0457.idiomatic: The Song sent men bearing salt and grain into Xiangyang; our forces seized the supplies.

s0458.literal: Prince Oljei was granted a camel-knob gold-plated silver seal.
s0458.idiomatic: Prince Oljei received a camel-knob gold-plated silver seal.

s0459.literal: In the eleventh month, on guimao day, Goryeo Commander-in-Chief Choi Tan and others, because Lin Yan had risen in rebellion, brought more than fifty western capital cities to submit.
s0459.idiomatic: On guimao day of the eleventh month Goryeo commander-in-chief Choi Tan and others, citing Lin Yan's rebellion, brought more than fifty western capital cities over to the Yuan.

s0460.literal: On dingwei day, three thousand troops under Wang Zhen and Hong Chagiu were conscripted to pacify Goryeo.
s0460.idiomatic: On dingwei day three thousand troops under Wang Zhen and Hong Chagiu were conscripted to pacify Goryeo.

s0461.literal: Goryeo Western Capital Commander-in-Chief Li Yanling requested additional troops; Mangudai was dispatched with two thousand men to join him.
s0461.idiomatic: Goryeo western capital commander Li Yanling requested reinforcements; Mangudai was sent with two thousand men to join him.

s0462.literal: On gengwu day, an edict stated: "Widowers, widows, orphans, and the disabled in all routes shall receive two dou of rice monthly.
s0462.idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict ordered that widowers, widows, orphans, and the disabled in all routes receive two dou of rice each month.

s0463.literal: The King of Annam, Chen Guangbing, sent envoys with tribute.
s0463.idiomatic: King Chen Guangbing of Annam sent envoys with tribute.

s0464.literal: Jinan suffered famine; one hundred twenty-eight thousand nine hundred shi of rice was issued for relief.
s0464.idiomatic: Jinan suffered famine; one hundred twenty-eight thousand nine hundred shi of rice was issued for relief.

s0465.literal: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent his Vice Minister of Rites Pak Hyo to enter court with Qara; his memorial stated that on receiving the edict he had already been restored to the throne and would soon come in audience.
s0465.idiomatic: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent vice minister of rites Pak Hyo to court with Qara; his memorial stated that he had already been restored on receiving the edict and would soon come in audience.

s0466.literal: A new city was built on the west bank of the Han River.
s0466.idiomatic: A new city was built on the west bank of the Han River.

s0467.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuzi day, the Dong'an Hun River embankment was built.
s0467.idiomatic: On wuzi day of the twelfth month the Dong'an Hun River embankment was built.

s0468.literal: On jichou day, Buddhist rites were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple for seven days and nights.
s0468.idiomatic: On jichou day Buddhist rites were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple for seven days and nights.

s0469.literal: Gaotang and Gu'an prefectures suffered famine; twenty thousand six hundred shi of rice was issued for relief.
s0469.idiomatic: Gaotang and Gu'an suffered famine; twenty thousand six hundred shi of rice was issued for relief.

s0470.literal: Zhangde, Huaimeng, and Weihui were split into three routes; Linlu County was promoted to Lin Prefecture; Zhen Prefecture was again changed to Hancheng County; ten prefectures and counties including Fengyi were consolidated; and Yizhou, Guangning, and other prefectures were placed under Dongjing.
s0470.idiomatic: Zhangde, Huaimeng, and Weihui were split into three routes; Linlu County was promoted to Lin Prefecture; Zhen Prefecture was again made Hancheng County; ten prefectures and counties including Fengyi were consolidated; and Yizhou, Guangning, and other prefectures were placed under Dongjing.

s0471.literal: That year, registered households empire-wide numbered one million six hundred eighty-four thousand one hundred fifty-seven.
s0471.idiomatic: That year registered households empire-wide numbered one million six hundred eighty-four thousand one hundred fifty-seven.

s0472.literal: Princes were granted gold, silver, silks, and cloth according to the annual precedent.
s0472.idiomatic: Princes received gold, silver, silks, and cloth according to the annual precedent.

s0473.literal: Forty-two persons were sentenced to death.
s0473.idiomatic: Forty-two persons were sentenced to death.
